subject: reasoning
question:
Six students, Ram, Gopi, Sita, Vimal, Tony and John, are sitting in a straight row facing north. Only two people sit to the left of Sita. Only two people sit between Sita and Vimal. Ram sits to the immediate right of Tony. Gopi sits to the immediate left of John. John is not a neighbour of Vimal.

Who sits second from the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Six students, Ram, Gopi, Sita, Vimal, Tony and John, are sitting in a straight row facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the left of Sita.

2) Only two people sit between Sita and Vimal.
